Based on what's on those two pages, there's **no difference** — so there's no reason to pick one over the other from the listings alone.

Both are for the exact same product:

|---|---|---|

| **Availability / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. |
| **Fulfillment** | Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio | Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty. | 1-year limited warranty. |
| **Specs / In the box** | over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, graphite - headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable | Identical |

In other words: same headphones, same price, same rating, same shipping time, same return policy, and same warranty.

* seller reviews / reputation outside of that product rating
* customer service experience
* payment protection

But from just A vs B as listed, either one is the same deal.
